metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I swear enemy hit ‘ghost mode’ but forgot to move
metadata.description:
Wait, did they seriously just stand there?
My aim was on a coffee break but somehow pulled off 2 kills.
Click if you love when Valorant logic takes a day off!
Tap if your kills feel like happy accidents too.

Hit play if your aim ghosts but the kills still land!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
